developers.nav.label: Developer documentation
developers.overview.body: Bots that talk in a community's channels and activities that play out in its voice rooms — all running on the community's own server. These guides are the documents from the LobbyForge repository.
developers.overview.build.body: Bots reach a community over HTTPS with a token; plugins run inside the server itself. Pick the piece you need.
developers.overview.build.title: What you can build
developers.overview.card.bots.body: Give a program a bot token and it can read and post in a community's text channels over plain HTTPS, from any language.
developers.overview.card.bots.title: Bots
developers.overview.card.commands.body: Register /commands that members run from the message box, and answer publicly or only to the member who ran one.
developers.overview.card.commands.title: Slash commands
developers.overview.card.compiled.body: Build a game or activity with its own panel and hidden information per player, and ship it in your own image.
developers.overview.card.compiled.title: Compiled-in plugins
developers.overview.card.events.body: Receive messages, member joins and command runs over the WebSocket gateway as they happen, instead of polling.
developers.overview.card.events.title: Event stream
developers.overview.card.marketplace.bod: Publish a plugin bundle that a community's owner reviews and installs while the server runs. It runs in the sandboxed plugin worker, not in the web app.
developers.overview.card.webhooks.body: Let a game server or CI post into a channel with an incoming webhook, or have events delivered, signed, to your own HTTPS endpoint.
developers.overview.card.webhooks.title: Webhooks
developers.overview.guides.title: Read the guides
developers.overview.source.body: Self-hosting, translation and architecture notes live in the repository's docs folder. Spotted a mistake? Every guide here has an Edit on GitHub link.
